verdict.rationale: Polar documents Checkout Links: you configure a checkout in the dashboard, share the URL anywhere, and Polar handles the rest, so no payment UI needs to be built. A Checkout Session API covers programmatic flows, and the sandbox lets you test the full checkout funnel. missing for 10: evidence that the hosted page is conversion-optimized (e.g. localized payment methods or optimization claims), explicit documentation of redirect/success-URL handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the hosted checkout experience.
